theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_hr_monotone_set_trichotomy
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet F → (∀ a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), 0 ≤ inner ℝ a v → ∀ᵐ z ∂volume, z ∈ F → z + a ∈ F) → volume F = 0 ∨ volume Fᶜ = 0 ∨ ∃ c : ℝ, volume (symmDiff F {z | c < inner ℝ z v}) = 0
